title: Split routing proxy into planner + allocator with transactional fallback boundaries
creator: Aisha Patel
description: The current routing proxy mixes route planning (policy evaluation, affinity scoring) with capacity allocation (region/zone selection, lease acquisition). This coupling increases lock contention on the global routing context, makes fallbacks hard to reason about, and forces broad rollouts for small changes. This ticket splits the proxy into two runtime components — a lightweight planner that returns an immutable decision envelope, and an allocator that materializes that decision against live capacity. We will also introduce explicit transactional boundaries around fallback decisions so that a single allocator failure does not retroactively mutate planner output for concurrent requests.
acceptance_criteria: Planner component compiles policy decisions into an immutable decision-envelope (JSON schema v1) and is reachable via internal gRPC endpoint
Allocator consumes decision-envelopes and resolves region/instance leases without mutating planner state
Fallbacks are handled within allocator with transactional semantics: either a safe fallback variant is chosen or the original decision is marked as failed; no in-flight planner state is rewritten
End-to-end regression tests show P99 routing latency unchanged (+/-5ms) and 30% reduction in global mutex contention under synthetic surge
Telemetry updated: per-stage latency (planner/allocator), per-region circuit-breaker events, and new histogram for fallback frequency
Canary rollout plan documented and executed: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with automatic rollback on error-rate spike
implementation_notes: Extract policy evaluation into routing/planner package. Planner returns decision-envelope with fields: model_variant, region_affinity_scores, fallback_candidates, routing_version
Introduce allocator service in routing/allocator package that reads envelope and performs lease acquisition, KV-cache hinting, and final route binding
Replace global routing mutex with per-shard read-owner pattern. Planner read-hotpath should be lock-free in common case (RCU-like snapshotting)

Add transactional fallback boundary: allocator provides TryAllocate() which either returns AllocatedRoute or a deterministic FallbackDecision; allocator writes failure markers to a dedicated metric stream instead of mutating planner outputs
Upgrade protobufs to 3.24.1 and regenerate route proto stubs. Validate backwards compatibility with existing control-plane clients
Add feature flag `routing.split_planner_allocator` with staged rollout and server-side gating in the control plane
Keep legacy proxy shim for 2 weeks post-stable release to allow migration of Dedicated and Private clusters
